instruction: Studio portrait photograph, medium shot. Against a solid light blue background, three women pose together. On the left, the Asian woman in a beige tank top (R1) smiles at the camera, holding the arm of the curly-haired woman in a beige tank top (R2) in the center. The curly-haired woman also smiles forward. On the right, the afro-haired woman in a beige tank top (R3) hugs the curly-haired woman from behind, smiling widely at the camera. Soft studio lighting illuminates the scene.
elements: R2 is the contacted central person between R1 and R3
R1 and R2 smile forward while R3 smiles widely at the camera
